column1: # Every URL the live site served on 2026-10-18, found by crawling its pages
# and listing the old site's files, each with the status a HEAD request got
# that day. _scripts/check-urls.rb checks every build against it, and the
# GitHub check runs it after every push. New pages need no row. Remove a row
# only when the user agrees a page is gone for good.
# 200: must exist in the new build at exactly this path.
# 302: S3 redirect to the trailing-slash form. Only the target has to exist.
# 403: missing on S3, which answers 403 rather than 404. The thesis PDF was
#      uploaded to master in September 2026 and never deployed. It must
# Paths are percent-encoded the way the live HTML links them.
# Two deliberate changes on 2026-10-25, at the user's request: two images live
# with a space in their names were renamed, retiring the old addresses.
